name: What features are typically included in an accessible bathroom remodel?

mainEntity.name: What features are typically included in an accessible bathroom remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common features include curbless or roll-in showers with grab bars and built-in seating, comfort-height toilets, reinforced walls for future grab bar installation, non-slip flooring, and lever-style faucets for easier operation. Other considerations are adjustable or wall-mounted sinks with clear knee space, wider doors, and improved lighting. The specific features depend on individual needs and the bathroom's layout.
acceptedAnswer.description: Typical features include roll-in showers, grab bars, comfort-height toilets, non-slip flooring, lever faucets, and accessible sinks.
